answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 63386 Country: India Title: Zikr and Quranic ayat for rizq. Question: Please give me zikr or Quranic ayat for rizq and to pay debt and for barakah in my house. Please help me make dua. Answer ID: 63386 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 396/385/H=04/1437) Recite Surah Quraish 11-11 times after each salah as well as at the time of going to bed with durood 11-11 times before and after, and then supplicate Allah. Do not violate the rights of anyone, love and have good conduct with your relatives and near ones; treat poor and needy ones nicely. In-shaAllah, it shall benefit you a lot. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
